designationHistory.name: Key West Reservation
designationHistory.indexText: President Theodore Roosevelt set aside the keys and islands west of Key West, Florida, as the Key West Reservation, a preserve and breeding ground for native birds, by Executive Order 923.
designationHistory.note: The FWS file holds a copy of the signed order, marked No. 923 and dated August 8, 1908. Renamed Key West National Wildlife Refuge by Proclamation 2416, July 25, 1940. Signed the same day as EO 924 (Klamath Lake Reservation).
